Northwind Software - Employee Policy Handbook v4.1
Page 6
Working Hours and Overtime
The standard working time is 8 hours a day and 40 hours a week, including a lunch break of 45
minutes.
Flexible hours
You can start between 8 am and 11 am, as long as you are available during core hours from
10 am to 4 pm and complete 8 hours.
Overtime
Overtime must be approved by your manager before you work it. Employees in salary grades 1
to 3 are paid overtime at twice the hourly rate. Employees in higher grades get compensatory
time off instead of overtime pay.
Compensatory off
If you work on a weekly holiday or a public holiday, you get one compensatory day off, to be
taken within 60 days.
Rest between shifts
Shift employees must have at least 11 hours of rest between the end of one shift and the start
of the next.
